inputs.label: Monochrome
inputs.coverage: Dawn FC2 body-fixed orthorectified global mosaic. The PDS bundle-block adjustment uses Dawn orbit/attitude and the high-resolution Ceres shape model for ray intersections; the Kait-anchored longitude system is shared with the Dawn shape/topography work. Observed pixels, shadows, and mosaic seams are preserved. Exactly black pixels connected to the southern source border are marked with the shared neutral gray cartographic grid before reprojection. No inferred terrain or inpainting; the extreme south pole and other source gaps remain missing.
